title: Salud Digital ICU Mortality Transfer Reproducibility Package
description: Reproducibility package for the Salud Digital ICU mortality prediction study. The package contains analysis scripts, aggregate non-patient-level outputs, variable documentation, execution instructions, environment files, and revised manuscript materials for evaluating intra-domain validation and cross-domain transfer between MIMIC-III Demo and eICU-CRD. Patient-level MIMIC/eICU raw or derived records are not included because the source databases are PhysioNet clinical resources subject to credentialing, data-use agreements, and access controls.
